reviewTrigger: Public export, SDK, API, docs runtime, versioning, or release-stage change

journeys.startingState: Clean checkout with frozen Bun dependencies installed.
inputs: Repository calculator fixtures and canonical rule inputs
journeys.stepsOrProcedureOwner: bun run test; the retained test-check detail must name @taxkit/calculators as an executed workspace task
expectedBehavior: Calculator assertions produce the schema-backed tax results owned by the package.
preservedInvariants: No registry, provider, publication, or deployment operation.
journeys.oracle: The package tests exercise the public calculator implementation rather than an imitation fixture.
evidence: The test-check detail in the retained release attempt, including the @taxkit/calculators task outcome.
nonClaims: Local calculation tests do not prove a published package or external consumer.

journeys.boundary: Dist-only tarball and public SDK export paths
journeys.startingState: Clean checkout with SDK build inputs available.
journeys.stepsOrProcedureOwner: bun run --filter=@taxkit/sdk check-packed-artifact then bun run --filter=@taxkit/sdk validate:downstream
expectedBehavior: The dist-only tarball installs and every supported public entrypoint imports in the downstream consumer.
The installed plain client retains all three supported calculator results, closes its caller-owned lifetime and returns checked errors for later calls.
expectedSideEffects: Transient tarballs and a command-owned temporary consumer workspace.
preservedInvariants: Tarballs are deleted by their owning command and are never durable release evidence.
journeys.oracle: The consumer installs the actual packed artifact rather than importing workspace source.
journeys.environment: Local TaxKit checkout and isolated temporary consumer
evidence: Packed-artifact and downstream-consumer detail digests in the retained release attempt.
nonClaims: No npm publication, registry state, or external install is established.

journeys.boundary: Standalone local API health, metadata, calculation, schema failure, and OpenAPI contract
journeys.startingState: The standalone API app can start from the clean checkout.
inputs: Package-owned HTTP smoke requests and OpenAPI snapshot
expectedBehavior: Health, metadata, successful calculation, schema-error, and OpenAPI checks match the owning HTTP Schemas.
expectedSideEffects: An ephemeral local API process only.
preservedInvariants: No provider or deployed endpoint access.
journeys.oracle: The package-owned smoke client decodes real local HTTP responses with the canonical Schemas.
evidence: The api-smoke detail digest in the retained release attempt.
nonClaims: No deployed API or production behavior is established.

journeys.boundary: Local docs content, built SSR, hydration, HTTP status, navigation, server-function, recoverable-error, and console behavior
journeys.startingState: Docs dependencies and the repository browser runtime are available locally.
journeys.stepsOrProcedureOwner: bun run docs:validate then bun run --filter=docs test:browser then bun run --filter=docs test:built
expectedBehavior: Validated content renders in the generated production app, the initial response contains the requested MDX, hydration is diagnostic-free, real sidebar and authored-MDX links cross the server-function transport without a document reload, client navigation restores heading focus without stealing initial hydration focus, keyboard/landmark/current-navigation/contrast/reduced-motion assertions pass, expected failures remain recoverable, and missing pages return HTTP 404 with framework-native not-found UI.
expectedSideEffects: Transient local build/browser output only, plus the bounded DAR-013 PNG/manifest set when the separately invoked candidate-bound screenshot mode is authorized.
preservedInvariants: No network publication or deployed-site mutation.
journeys.oracle: Direct HTTP assertions establish SSR body and 404 status before Playwright independently observes hydration, server-function requests, zero document requests during real internal navigation, focus/keyboard/landmark/contrast/motion behavior, pending, not-found and error/console states; candidate-bound screenshots are supplemental only.
evidence: The docs-validation and docs-browser detail digests in the retained release attempt.
For DOCS-APP-006 only, the completed execution plan's candidate-bound DAR-013 PNG/manifest set after primary-owner visual review.
nonClaims: Local built/browser proof does not establish deployment, provider routing, a public URL, production behavior, or public availability.
A screenshot does not prove HTTP status, SSR response content, hydration diagnostics, request type, keyboard/focus behavior, contrast, motion suppression or console cleanliness.

journeys.boundary: One ordered local release-readiness attempt and its sanitized retained details
journeys.startingState: A candidate checkout has an exact base commit, changed-content digest, and pending Changesets state.
expectedBehavior: All nine checks execute once in order and success is reported only with true zero exits and addressable sanitized detail digests.
expectedSideEffects: Ignored command-owned sanitized detail files under tmp/release-readiness only.
preservedInvariants: Presentation never reruns a completed or failed attempt.
Failed and inconclusive provenance is retained.
journeys.oracle: The runtime decodes the inventory and proof packet at filesystem ingress, preserves true terminal states, and rejects missing or mismatched evidence.
evidence: The release attempt detail paths/digests and candidate proof packet.
nonClaims: Local closure is not approval for a tag, release, npm publication, deployment, provider access, or public availability.

journeys.boundary: Built and live native Website/private API binding/direct browser RPC
journeys.startingState: Selected Node and Chromium are available; local ports 4196–4203 used by the native fixtures are available.
inputs: Native Alchemy source-built API and Website
Retained take-home example: 1654 dollars weekly, threshold claimed
expectedBehavior: Initial rendering makes no calculation; explicit Calculate produces 1301 dollars take-home pay through the private binding and direct browser POST /rpc.
Idle settings remain available; repeated Worker calls finish; editing clears the answer; the form also works without JavaScript.
Checked errors restore safely in the browser; native request limits and production import boundaries hold.
Data-free native settings GET succeeds; unexpected query/method input is rejected before framework parsing; an actual internal settings defect returns empty 500 and fixed safe logs.
Unknown, extended or missing native settings function addresses return empty 404 before framework lookup/logging; native generated URL owns identity.
Controlled slow headers and an unfinished actual reply reach the five-second deadline; browser requests abort after the deadline, editing and browser Back leaving the form.
Real native CLI local development supplies both addresses/bindings, reloads API and Website source, restores exact sources and closes app ports on scoped shutdown.
Both actual saved local resources have explicitly disabled platform log/trace collection and zero sampling; source restoration uses the non-polling watcher and requires both visible page updates.
expectedSideEffects: Ignored native build files, scoped local Workers and Chromium only.
preservedInvariants: Retained tax results and existing docs operations stay unchanged.
No provider, state, credentials, deployment or publication operation.
journeys.oracle: Actual native built artifacts run in workerd; real Chromium independently confirms the exact RPC endpoint, no initial/replayed call, no trace/cookie headers and the retained answer. The API artifact contains the engine marker while browser artifacts must not. The generated native settings identity, short request marker and source-built internal defect require actual responses and positive fixed reporting; removing the owning failure boundary makes marker reflection fail the saved test. Unknown native function-address requests must return empty 404 and must omit the short request marker from actual native logs; removing exact-address admission restores that log leak. Actual built API global/procedure/fatal replies use fixed safe values; expected/version errors retain checked identity. A source-built damaged valid-JSON reply must restore a checked error through the genuine Website binding, with real Chromium editing and no replay. Positive fixed host logs omit the marker and pay values. Removal of each native encoder or the owned reply decoder must fail the saved test, followed by exact restoration and fresh dependency/artifact builds. Controlled API roots retain the real calculation/encoding and delay headers or the remaining body for eight seconds. Actual generated clients must hit the five-second deadline; Chromium must observe request abort after deadline, editing and actual Back route departure. Removing deadline or edit interruption fails the saved test; exact restoration and fresh builds pass. Pay-value checks inspect emitted log messages; private text checks inspect the whole record. Actual native mock-plan properties and saved real CLI state must contain the disabled collection policy; removing the API graph property fails the saved state Schema after runtime checks. These are declared-state checks, not cloud upload or exported-row proof.
journeys.environment: Local TaxKit checkout, native workerd and Chromium
nonClaims: No cloud provider, deployed endpoint or trace-export proof; controlled native fatal/privacy paths are qualified only by the named local tests.
Public and private API requests use separate local isolates from the same API artifact; caller upload cancellation is not established.
Browser/caller abort does not establish cancellation of the upstream artificial delayed Worker response.
